harnesses.note: Neither conductor is GND. Original M16 hold retained. P2/J51 carries main battery current; 0.1A TL2230 direct wiring rejected. Rated power executor unresolved.

harnesses.note: Panel jack terminal polarity by actual contact; not a motherboard DC socket.

harnesses.title: LONG-PRESS POWER: UNRESOLVED
harnesses.note: VI/VO recovered from user drawing; no connection to J51; M16 bypass conflict.

harnesses.title: DUAL EYE UART + POWER
harnesses.note: Use LCD1 SH1.0-14P, not LCD2. Device connector drawing station; physical contact geometry provisional.

harnesses.title: EYE LOCAL 3V3 REFERENCE
harnesses.note: Do not use motherboard 3V3 instead of LCD1 local reference.

harnesses.title: LEFT RD03E
harnesses.note: Protocol and voltage qualification pending; OT2/pin5 remains disconnected.

harnesses.title: RIGHT RD03E
harnesses.note: Protocol and voltage qualification pending; OT2/pin5 remains disconnected.

harnesses.title: REAR RD03E
harnesses.note: Use J14 as third S3 channel. Fourth J36 is unused.

harnesses.title: GROVE IMU
harnesses.note: Existing J4 1:1 electrical map. Connector exit envelope to be sample checked.

harnesses.title: HORIZONTAL COMPASS
harnesses.note: Reversed function order between Grove and PH2.0; magnetic calibration pending.

harnesses.title: TOF I2C CANDIDATE
harnesses.note: Open tips: carrier IO voltage and power-off behavior not established.

harnesses.title: TOF SHARED SUPPLY CANDIDATE
harnesses.note: J16 entirely disconnected. Shared J37 ZERO3V3 prevents independent relay power cycling; carrier VIN and IO remain unqualified. ULD controls stop/sleep.

harnesses.title: 5010 5V 4-WIRE B3 PWM
harnesses.note: User confirms seller pin table: 1 black GND, 2 yellow +5V, 3 green FG, 4 blue PWM. Actual SKU is 5V despite diagram's 12V text. PWM/FG electrical levels remain unqualified.

harnesses.title: USB AUDIO SERVICE CABLE
harnesses.note: Use finished USB-C data cable. Four cores are explanatory; rear top route requires a suitably thin flat cable and qualified bend/plug envelope; shielding/CC omitted.

harnesses.title: SPEAKER SERVICE CABLE
harnesses.note: Neither speaker wire is system ground. Lower pair runs side by side to preserve battery height allowance; 145mm factory lead may require a verified extension.

harnesses.title: CAMERA CSI RIBBON
harnesses.note: User-confirmed camera/FFC. Ribbon is not 15 independent loose wires.
